verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow (can → headline → CTA). But the NEW badge, legal line and missing-sticker placeholder are crammed into one tiny strip under the headline: the legal text and badge can't be read, the placeholder touches the legal text, and the CTA sits about 13px from the right edge. B has the same broken bottom strip (unreadable legal text, shrunken NEW badge, sticker crammed against it). It also flips the reading order so the CTA comes first on the far left, jammed near the edge, and the product sits at the end on the right, which makes it the weaker layout.
